subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@acme.com>, Lily Tran <lily.tran@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T14:05:00Z
Subject: Recap: POC goals, scope, and next steps (follow-up from today)

Hi Ethan / Lily -

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned for the POC kickoff next week. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain & goals:
- Pain: Inconsistent summary quality from current in-house model; high latency for long docs (~10-12s) that ruins UX.
- Business goal: Improve summary accuracy and reduce median summary latency to <= 2.5s for typical docs (<= 5k tokens).
- Success metrics: 1) human-rated summary quality >= 4/5 on seed prompt set, 2) median latency <= 2.5s, 3) cost-per-1k-tokens below current infra baseline (TBD).

Scope of the POC:
- Duration: 6 weeks, with a mid-point review at week 3.
- Workstreams: data & access (sample docs + S3 access), prompt set & evals (we'll provide seed prompts; Acme will add edge cases), infra & integration (test endpoint, authentication), and monitoring (latency/cost dashboards).

Owners & roles:
- Acme: Ethan (POC lead) - provide sample corpus, success criteria sign-off, and API access for integration testing.
- Redwood: Marissa (engage owner) - rollout coordination & prompt engineering; Rishi (solutions eng) - infra setup & latency tuning; Neha (customer success) - project cadence and metrics tracking.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Ethan: share S3 read-only credentials and a 200-doc sample set by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-03).
2) Marissa: send SOW + onboarding checklist (attached) and a proposed timeline by tomorrow.
3) Rishi: provision a test endpoint and share API creds; aim for initial access by 2026-08-04.
4) Both teams: finalize prompt seed set in shared Drive (link below).

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow.pdf (SOW + success metrics template), acme-prompt-set.xlsx (seed prompts template).

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lily Tran <lily.tran@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: POC goals, scope, and next steps (follow-up from today)

Thanks Marissa - very clear. Couple quick clarifications: 

1) For the sample set we will include a mix of long-form reports (~4k-6k tokens) and short notes (~200-400 tokens). That should cover the latency distribution.
2) On cost: we can share current cost numbers next week but would like Redwood's estimate on potential savings assuming batching + KV caching.

Action items from our side:
- I will share the S3 read-only credentials and a 200-doc sample by 2026-08-03 EOD (Lily will upload).
- We'll confirm a 30-minute kickoff on 2026-08-04 at 10:00 PT - OK for your team?

Lily and I also noted a security checklist item: we require SOC 2 attestation copy and a contact for security questionnaire follow-ups.

Ethan
Director, AI Platform
Acme Corp
ethan.ross@acme.com
